purpose: Select CPU thread count on validation requests; freeze selection before confirmation and first test-split quality evaluation
hypothesis: Default four intra-op threads are not necessarily optimal for small MiniLM CPU requests; tuning thread count can improve latency without changing precision policy
selection: Fastest per-variant median of round medians, tie by smaller thread count. Quantized candidate is faster of per-channel and one-node-excluded variants, both already within 0.005 validation Spearman of FP32. No tuning on test split or confirmation measurements.
limits: Thresholds are project engineering targets, not industry certification. One host, no CPU affinity/thermal control, no production traffic, no power claim. STS-B public test is new to this project iteration, not newly created blind data; pretraining overlap not audited.
